diversity_policy: Later slots request useful diversity, but byte-identical patches remain valid when the same edit is the best supported repair. Sampling seeds and strategy guidance vary by slot.
proposal_contract: The LLM emits exactly one contiguous edit. Candidate identity, repair intent, desired behavior, constraints, and uncertainty come deterministically from RepairSpec.
patch_policy: Each slot starts from the original faulty program for one RepairSpec anchor; patches are never accumulated.
validation_policy: Agent2 validates edit scope/application and compilation. Runtime checks run only when explicitly supplied or auto_crash_check is enabled.
workspace_policy: Clean project copies are temporary and removed after validation.
repair_spec_firewall: Only RepairSpec evidence linked to the current anchor is sent to the LLM; provenance IDs and structured MR/test facts are preserved.
